During the attack on [[Juma 9]], a '''Tactical Droid''' led the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the space station. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] entered Juma 9 and made their way to the control bridge, he sent in most of his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to kill the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. They were quickly cut down. The Jedi destroyed the tactical droid and wiped out the other droids on the space station.
